remarks: Beautiful large studio in a historic landmark elevator building on Washington Street. The unit is fully furnished and boasts high ceilings, large windows, hardwood floor, modern recess lighting, ample storage space and a personal washer/dryer in unit. Updated kitchen features granite countertops, center island, refrigerator, electric stove with oven, and microwave. The unit is furnished and has in-unit hot water heater. Personal intercom and security buzzed in at front door of building. Steps away from Metro North Train. Direct access to the municipal parking lot in rear. Short walk to the Norwalk River, Oyster Shell Park and SoNo Collection. Comfortable commute to New York City. Enjoy the vibrant and sought-after SoNo restaurants, retail shops and nightlife scene, combined with museums, galleries and beautiful waterfront. Near major highways, transportation and shopping centers. Owner pays for water. Tenant pays electric. No smoking allowed. Credit/background check and employment verification required. Tours available upon request. Owner pays for water. Renter is responsible for electric. No smoking allowed.
